[B1] < UserX | 'key' : OldKey , ... > $ UserX 'openWindow' cloudA | (deviceA)
=> < UserX | 'key' : FreshKey , ... > $ cloudA 'openWindow' deviceA | (FreshKey) .
[B1] < deviceA | 'key' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'openWindow' deviceA | (Key)
=> < deviceA | 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B2] < deviceA | 'key' : Key , 'trusted' : (Trusted) , ... > $ UserX 'bind' deviceA | (Key)
=> < deviceA | 'key' : Key , 'trusted' : (UserX , Trusted) , ... > .
[B3] < deviceA | 'trusted' : (UserX , Trusted) , 'power' : 'off' , ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' deviceA
=> < deviceA | 'trusted' : (UserX , Trusted) , 'power' : 'on' , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'turnOnViaCloud' cloudA | (deviceA)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'turnOn' deviceA .
[B4] < deviceA | 'trusted' : (cloudA , Trusted) , 'power' : 'off' , ... > $ cloudA 'turnOn' deviceA
=> < deviceA | 'trusted' : (cloudA , Trusted) , 'power' : 'on' , ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA , 'members' : (Members) , ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA , 'members' : (UserY , Members) , ...) , UserY : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA , 'members' : (Members) , ...) , UserY : ('device' : DeviceY , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA , 'members' : (UserY , Members) , ...) , UserY : ('device' : DeviceY , ...) , ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : nils , 'members' : (Members) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : nils , 'members' : (UserY , Members) , ...) , ... > .
[B6] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , ...) , UserY : ('device' : DeviceY , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'kick' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (Members) , ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ... > .
